title: A List of Places to Go: Waypoints With Tolerances, Dwell and Timeouts, Skipping or Giving Up, and Resuming After a Reboot Without Starting Over

artifact.note: a waypoint mission for a ground vehicle: a list of waypoints each with a tolerance, a dwell time, a timeout and a speed; a leg is reached when the vehicle comes within the tolerance (and has stayed for the dwell time); a leg that times out is skipped or ends the mission, by policy; and the progress is saved as text, so a vehicle that reboots goes on from the leg it was on
